programme.title: Herreklubben
programme.desc: Hvad hvis vi droppede amerikanske varer? Blok og Alves undersøger, hvad vi kunne undvære – og hvad vi ville savne. Et sjovt og tankevækkende afsnit om afhængighed af USA og mulige alternativer. Husk at følge Herreklubben!

programme.title: Her er dit madliv
programme.sub-title: Her er dit madliv - Season 1 - Episode 012
programme.desc: True crime-ekspert Stine Bolther er aktuel med *Døde sjæle synger ikke* sammen med Jussi Adler-Olsen og Line Holm. Hør hvad hun spiser, når hun skriver krimistof – og om en craving fra hendes teenageår i København.

programme.title: Endestationen
programme.sub-title: Lig i lasten Speciel: Emil Thorup
programme.desc: Emil Thorup sætter sig ind i rustvognen til en samtale om liv, død – og alt det imellem. Han deler sin kamp mod hudkræft og sin passion for longevity. Med alvor og charme reflekterer han over sundhed, frygt og fremtidens store spørgsmål.

programme.title: Her er dit madliv
programme.sub-title: Her er dit madliv - Season 1 - Episode 015
programme.desc: Simi Jan fortæller om mad i Shaolin-templet, sin pakistanske mors køkken og studietiden i Skotland. Hun har smagt sig gennem det meste af verden – og afslører selvfølgelig også sin guilty pleasure!

programme.title: Modig
programme.desc: Lars Seier Christensen gæster programmet til en ærlig samtale om investeringer, FC København, Nordkorea og livet som barejer. En personlig snak mellem to venner, der har kendt hinanden siden 2015 – og haft mange gode grin undervejs.

programme.title: Endestationen
programme.sub-title: Lig i lasten Speciel: Linse Kessler
programme.desc: I Endestationen sætter Linse Kessler sig ind i rustvognen og åbner op som aldrig før. Hun deler kærligheden til familien, sorgen over Mopper og tanker om livet efter døden. En stærk samtale med grin, tårer og ærlige refleksioner om livets dybde.

programme.title: Riis & Støiholm
programme.desc: I afsnit 8 er Pernille Vermund månedens gæst. Vi dykker ned i hendes baggrund, livet før Christiansborg, balancen mellem politik og privatliv – og hvordan Jonathan Spang egentlig kysser. Underholdende og ærligt med Riis & Støiholm.

programme.title: Skål for sandheden
programme.desc: I “Skål For Sandheden” får Rasmus besøg af realitydronningerne Janni Ree og Vivi Bach. Plastikoperationer, numse-fiaskoer og ærlige familieforhold vendes i en ærlig og uforbeholden snak. Intet bliver pakket ind – god fornøjelse!

programme.title: Her er dit madliv
programme.sub-title: Her er dit madliv - Season 1 - Episode 007
programme.desc: Kokken Hannah Grant elsker protein og træning – og hun tæller gram, ikke kalorier! Hun har været både skibskok og kok for cykelryttere. Hendes guilty pleasure overrasker – og Louisa har aldrig smagt den før!

programme.title: Skål for sandheden
programme.desc: Rasmus får besøg af kærlighedsduoen Nina Ettrup og Eva Lund, der deler om deres kærlighedsliv på tv, fremtidsdrømme og udfordringer ved at date med hele Danmark som dommer. Spørgsmål fra skålen giver ærlige og saftige snakke i Skål For Sandheden.

programme.title: Modig
programme.desc: Jotam Confino gæster studiet og fortæller om sine oplevelser i Israel som journalist for nationale og internationale medier. Han deler også sin tilgang til kritik og vigtigheden af ærlighed i journalistik. En spændende og tankevækkende samtale.

programme.title: Hvad gjorde dig til
programme.sub-title: Hvad gjorde dig til - Season 1 - Episode 006
programme.desc: Tidligere frygtet bandemedlem, som engang forsøgte at skade en anden i en brutal konflikt. Efter fængsel har han vendt livet om, lever stabilt med familie og bruger sin historie til at hjælpe unge væk fra kriminalitet.

programme.title: Skål for sandheden
programme.desc: I “Skål For Sandheden” besøger Mette Søndergaard Nielsen og Elisa Lykke Rasmus Lindbjerg til en sladderaften. De snakker Reddit, sex-skandaler og vild kærlighedsflugt. Intet pakkes ind – bare ærlig underholdning!

programme.title: Superfly
programme.desc: Superfly -the film that helped define a genre in its characters, look, sound, and feel -is reimagined with Director X, director of legendary music videos (Drake, Rihanna), introducing it to a new generation. The screenplay is by Alex Tse.

programme.title: Dirty (2006)
programme.desc: Hard-edged story of a gangbanger turned cop who is forced to choose between his conscience and his loyalty to the code of blue all in the course of one day.

programme.title: The Shepherd (2008)
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme stars in this hard-hitting action thriller about a border patrol agent who attempts to take down a rogue American Special Forces unit that's smuggling Afghan heroin into the United States.

programme.title: Kung Fu Hustle
programme.desc: KUNG FU HUSTLE perfectly blends original comedy and explosive martial arts action. Creative and imaginative characters slam together in a comic blend of Quentin Tarantino meets Jackie Chan in a filmthat goes beyond the limits of mere comedy.

programme.title: Robin and Marian
programme.desc: Sean Connery and Audrey Hepburn star as the legendary lovers Robin Hood and Maid Marion, who reunite twenty years after their first meeting. Now the mother superior of a nunnery, Marion finds herselfdrawn to a somewhat less agile Robin Hood when he returns from a lengthy Crusade in the Holy Lands.

programme.title: Sheena (1984)
programme.desc: Exotic Tanya Roberts stars as Sheena, a comic book legend that comes to life. As a child, she was lost in the African jungle and adopted by the Zambouli tribe. She rules over the untamed wilds of Africa, until outsiders challenge her domain in this exotic action-adventure.

programme.title: Suspect (1987)
programme.desc: This tension-filled courtroom drama opens with the suicide of a Supreme Court justice. Then the young Justice Department employee to whom he had given privileged information is discovered dead. A deaf-mute Vietnam veteran is charged with her murder and Cher, a public defender, is appointed counsel.

programme.title: Gloria (1980)
programme.desc: Rowlands garnered an Oscar nomination for her fierce portrayal as an ex-mob mistress who takes care of a young boy after his family is wiped out by the Mafia. Gloria must rely on all her street-savvy to prevent both herself and the boy from being the mobster's next target.

programme.title: And Justice For All
programme.desc: Al Pacino portrays a hot-shot lawyer looking for justice in a justice system run amok.

programme.title: Against All Odds (1984)
programme.desc: A dangerous love triangle develops when a shady nightclub owner hires an ex-football player to findhis runaway girlfriend.

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: Crouching Tiger Hidden Dragon is a timeless story that takes place in feudal China when miracles were credible and spirits and gods were present in man's world. It is not unbelievable that zen warriors float through the air, skim the water and battle in trees and on rooftops. Pain, revenge and duty are the stuff that bind us in this world and are the main plot line of the movie, but in the afterlife love and faith linger on.

programme.title: Priest (2011)
programme.desc: A vampire western about a warrior priest who disobeys church law by teaming with a young sheriff and a priestess to track down a band of renegade vampires who have kidnapped his niece. An adaptation of the action-horror TokyoPop comic book.

programme.title: Priest (2011)
programme.desc: A vampire western about a warrior priest who disobeys church law by teaming with a young sheriff and a priestess to track down a band of renegade vampires who have kidnapped his niece. An adaptation of the action-horror TokyoPop comic book.

programme.title: The Deep
programme.desc: Deep-sea divers vie with a Haitian drug dealer to recover a trunkload of sunken morphine. Based on Peter Benchley's best-selling novel.

programme.title: Cruel Intentions 2
programme.desc: School's never been more captivating -- or challenging -- than when a pair of unscrupulous siblingsset out to teach each other a lesson in this provocative textbook on deception, temptation and revenge. The prequel to Cruel Intentions.

programme.title: Diabolique (1996)
programme.desc: The wife and mistress of the sadistic dean of an exclusive prep school conspire to murder him.

programme.title: The Shadow Riders
programme.desc: In this made-for-TV movie, two brothers who battled on opposing sides of the Civil War return home at the end of the war to discover that their family has been kidnapped by Confederate forces.

programme.title: Return To The Blue Lagoon
programme.desc: Two children grow up on a deserted island unencumbered by civilization.

programme.title: Lawrence Of Arabia
programme.desc: Winner of seven Academy Awards(r), including Best Picture (1962), this is the restored director's cut of the breathtaking masterpiece.

programme.title: Close Encounters Of The Third Kind (Director's Cut)
programme.desc: We are not alone... A line worker, after an encounter with UFO's, feels undeniably drawn to an isolated area in the wilderness where something spectacular is about to happen.

programme.title: Silverado
programme.desc: Four drifters arrive in a small frontier town and become unlikely heroes in a battle against a powerful family and a corrupt sheriff.

programme.title: 8 Million Ways To Die
programme.desc: Trying to help a Los Angeles prostitute, an alcholoic ex-cop runs up against her vicious Colombian drug dealer boyfriend.

programme.title: Sniper (1993)
programme.desc: Tom Berenger is a bush-savvy Marine who teams with a political marksman (Billy Zane) to eliminate a Colombian drug lord in the jungles of Central America.

programme.title: Whatever It Takes (2000)
programme.desc: Best friends and neighbors, Ryan Woodman and Maggie Carter, are four weeks away from the prom, and they've agreed to go together if they don't have real dates. Then Chris, a cool guy from the football team, offers to help Ryan connect with Ashley, a popular blond. In exchange, a la Cyrano, Chris needs Ryan's help to get close to Maggie. Ryan makes the deal, helps the dastardly Chris play Maggie, takes advantage of Ashley's lack of self-esteem, loses his values, makes fun of his geeky friends, and falls in Maggie's estimation. Maggie is fooled by Chris, poised to be his next score. Before prom night is over, with its Titanic theme, will Ryan stop sinking?

programme.title: The Man Who Loved Women (1983)
programme.desc: In Blake Edwards' all-star romantic comedy, Burt Reynolds is David, a sculptor who is an incurable womanizer, who never met a woman he didn't love. He pays a visit to a psychiatrist, Marianna (Julie Andrews), in the hope of removing a creative block he's been experiencing; instead, he falls for her and she for him.

programme.title: The Lobster
programme.desc: A love story set in a dystopian near future where single people are arrested and transferred to a creepy hotel. There they are obliged to find a matching mate in 45 days. If they fail, they are transformed into an animal and released into the woods.

programme.desc: Commencement ceremony is over, it's time for Huntington High's graduation party as jocks, geeks, prom queens, and misfits alike make a statement about the past and plot the uncertain future in this raucous comedy.

programme.desc: A wedding planner finally meets "Mr. Right", but he's the groom from one of her upcoming weddings.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Although the date hasn't been set, Tony forbids Jeannie from accompanying Melissa and himself on their honeymoon. Grover Caldwell, a young State Department attaché, tells Tony that General Stone, Melissa's father, has accepted an ambassadorial post. General Stone announces he hopes to take Tony, his prospective son-in-law, along as his military aide. When Tony expresses his desire to remain with the space program, Melissa, who has been working to advance the marriage date, tells her father she will change Tony's mind. She suggests that Grover replace Roger as Tony's best man.Jeannie, determined to accompany Tony, prepares an oriental feast when Melissa and her father dine at Tony's. Before serving, Jeannie turns herself into a Filipino houseboy. Melissa suggests they take the houseboy to Europe with them. Tony is given a bachelor dinner in which Jeannie emerges dancing from a prop cake. Jeannie learns that Grover is an old boy friend of Melissa's. Before Jeannie is through, Grover tells Melissa he loves her. Tony is not completely unhappy to be left with Jeannie, when Grover and Melissa declare their intentions to marry.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie gets jealous on discovering that Tony has a sexy new secretary. Claiming to be a better one, Jeannie insists on joining the WAAFs and taking over the job. Remembering that his friend, Roger Healey, told him that all new WAAFs are being sent overseas, Tony agrees to help Jeannie to join. To her horror, she is sent to San Antonio for basic training. Jeannie has a series of disastrous tryouts in different job categories, in spite of her insistence that she wants an assignment as Captain Nelson's secretary when she becomes a WAAF.When Major Margaret Fiefeld assigns Jeannie as secretary to the commanding officer at the North African base instead, Jeannie folds her arms, blinks, and lands in Tony's office. Tony informs Jeannie that he is being sent to Nevada. Jeannie says she will resign and go with him. Tony then tells her that only troublesome, incompetent girls are discharged and that she cannot resign. Jeannie blinks again, the office is set is turmoil, and Tony resignedly welcomes Jeannie back to civilian life.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: After promising to spend an evening with Jeannie, Tony is tricked by his superiors into conducting aerospace tycoon P.J. Ferguson on a tour of the base. Ferguson's daughter, Nina, de-cides that Tony is her man. P.J. persuades Tony's superior to order Tony to have cocktails aboard his yacht. When Jeannie protests, Tony imprisons her in the vacuum cleaner. Later, after P.J. has Tony assigned to a cruise on his yacht, Mrs. Flaherty, Tony's cleaning woman, accidentally releases Jeannie from the vacuum cleaner. She immediately takes off for the yacht.Jeannie disappears from the yacht during an argument with Tony. Nina and P.J. are certain he has pushed her overboard. Charged with murder, Tony is arrested. Roger Healey, certain Tony has lost his mind, agrees to go to Tony's house and tell the walls and the vacuum cleaner of Tony's plight, Jeannie goes to Tony's cell. Her appearance convinces P.J. that Tony is innocent. Later, searching for privacy, Jeannie and Tony climb into her bottle.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: After telling Tony that he and Roger Healey have been tapped for a historic two-man space probe, scheduled to blast off the following week, Dr. Bellows asks him to report for a final check-up. When Tony asks Jeannie to return to her home, Jeannie asserts that since Tony freed her from the bottle, she belongs to him. She adds that she can give him a space capsule of his own. Tony tells Jeannie if he fails tomorrow's test, he will not go on the flight.Worried about Tony's safety, Jeannie causes him to blurt out the wrong answers to every test. Tony leaves Dr. Bellows, certain he has passed, but Jeannie tells him he has failed. Impressed by Tony's unhappiness, Jeannie goes to Dr. Bellows' office, where he is typing a report on Tony's unfortunate condition. Resorting to all her magic, Jeannie makes Bellows believe that he is not only losing his mind, but is near death. Tony is reassigned to the two-man flight. There, in outer space, Jeannie joins Tony as he floats from a tether attached to the capsule.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Feeling that Jeannie must widen her horizons, Tony gives her a book "How To Be A Woman." Following the book's advice, to share her work with her man, Jeannie neglects her chores and allows the house to go to pot. Reading the chapter on clothing the successful woman, Jeannie charges an expensive wardrobe, in-cluding a mink coat. Convinced by the book that a man should take the woman out to dinner, Jeannie steers Tony to expensive Cafe Scheherazade. She starts a row when she criticizes the authen-ticity of the Arabian dancing.Literally taking the author's advice, Jeannie becomes a career girl and performs miraculous feats of instantaneous cooking while demonstrating electric stoves. Her employer, Sam, feeling she has been planted to get him into trouble with the Better Business Bureau, fires her. Later, after Tony feels he has straightened out things at home, Jeannie hears a news report about the flight of a Russian female astronaut. Blinking her eyes, she is outfitted as an astronaut and insists on accompanying Tony into space.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Tony is assigned as technical director on a new astronaut movie being filmed in Hollywood. Jealous of the star, Rita Mitchell, Jeannie smuggles herself along. All of Jeannie's ruses, including a rainstorm, fail to keep Tony from getting close to Rita. Tony tells Jeannie he is lunching with Rita and jokingly tells Jeannie he would lunch with her instead if she were a star. Determined to become a movie celebrity, Jeannie, seeing a picture of Pola Negri, patterns her personality on the old-time vamp.Although her first try at getting into the movies is viewed as a gag, Jeannie manages to get a screen test with Jason Huberts, which arouses Tony's jealousy. When the test with Jason and Jeannie is shown, only Jason is visible and Jeannie suddenly realizes that genies do not register on film. She is consoled when Tony breaks a date with Rita and they register their footprints in front of Grauman's Chinese with all the movie greats.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie gets involved with the law when, invisible to everyone, she attempts to drive Tony's car. Angered, Tony orders her to leave. Jeannie is aware that Tony has been studying the desalinization of seawater. Playing for time, she tells Tony her great-grandfather solved the problem. Tony asks to meet her great grandfather and Jeannie goes to get him. Tony phones Leslie Staples at the Department of Agriculture and tells him he is on the verge of converting salt water to fresh. Jeannie returns with her great grandfather, Bilejik, who proves that he can produce fresh water from salt water.When Tony returns to find Bilejik, Jeannie and a policeman are in front of his house. Bilejik has been causing all sorts of trouble with the neighbors. While resolving the matter, Tony discovers that Bilejik used seeds as a filter. After Bilejik leaves, Tony jubilantly reports to Staples. Staples tells him that these seeds are from a plant extinct for almost two thousand years.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: A series of reports by eleven-year-old Custer to his father, Major Ulysses S. Jamison, on the strange feats of magic at Tony's house results in the Major taking his son to Dr. Bellows, the base psychiatrist. Bellows tells Custer he believes his story, and asks him to keep a close watch on Tony. A policeman catches Dr. Bellows and Custer peering into Tony's window and takes them inside for identification. While Bellows is telling Tony that Custer believes he has seen them levitate, Jeannie causes him to do so. Bellows bows out, feeling he has stumbled on a top-secret aerospace project.Tony voices his nervousness to Jeannie about being spied on by Custer. When Custer disappears, Tony accuses Jeannie of turning him into nothing. Angered, Jeannie leaves. Later, when Custer comes back, having spent the day at a carnival, Tony penitently begins searching for Jeannie. He is sure Jeannie has joined a carnival act and starts a riot at the sideshow when he mistakes a veiled woman for Jeannie. Jeannie returns home and starts pulling down all the shades to outwit Custer.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie is annoyed when Diane Rodney, a friend of Tony's, returns to town, determined to resume their old relationship. As a result, when Jeannie runs into Roger, while driving Tony's car, she accepts his invitation to dinner. Unaware that Jeannie is Roger's date, Tony instructs his friend in the fine art of courtship. Later, when Jeannie tells him she doesn't know her date's name, Tony begins to worry. When Diane arrives, Tony drags her all over town searching for Jeannie. The two couples finally meet at a nightclub. Alone with Jeannie, Tony demands she return home. Jeannie tells him she is going to listen to Roger's records.At Roger's apartment, Jeannie wards off all his attempts at romance. She leaves shortly before Tony pounds on the door looking for her. Tony points out to Roger all the mistakes he would be making if he married her. Convinced, Roger admits Tony has saved him from making a fool of himself. Jeannie is overjoyed by Tony's concern for her. Tony replies that, after all, he is only human.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie agrees not to date Roger if Tony doesn't go out with other girls. Then Tony and Roger are assigned to escort Russian cosmonauts Major Tiomkin and Major Posnovsky during a goodwill visit. Major Tiomkin proves to be a beautiful girl named Sonya, who immediately stakes a claim on Tony. Angered, Jeannie tells Tony she is going out with Roger. Tony imprisons Jeannie in her bottle. Jeannie maneuvers the bottle into the pocket of Roger's raincoat. Roger presents the bottle to Sonya. Tony gets involved in a fracas with General Barkley and Dr. Bellows in his unsuccessful try to get the bottle back. When Sonya opens the bottle, Jeannie appears. Pointing to Sonya as her new mistress, she tells the cosmonaut she can make her every wish come true.When the plane on which Sonya is scheduled to return leaves, Tony feels her country now has possession of a decisive secret weapon. Later, dripping furs and jewelry, Sonya comes to Tony's home. She tells him Jeannie has granted her fondest desire by turning her into a wealthy American. Sonya agrees to return the bottle if Tony marries her. Tony asks a last word with Jeannie. He tells Jeannie he can't marry Sonya. Jeannie solves the problem by creating a duplicate Tony for Sonya.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Unable to persuade Tony to marry her, Jeannie decides she needs a mother's counsel. She blinks her eyes and Mama appears. Mama assures Jeannie Tony will change his mind if he thinks Jeannie is going to marry Roger. Tony asks Roger if he has met Jeannie's parents. Then Dr. Bellows announces he has bought the lot across the street. Roger asks to meet Jeannie's parents. She produces a house on Dr. Bellows' lot. Tony sees Dr. Bellows and General Hadley approaching the lot. Responding to Tony's pleas, Jeannie makes the house vanish. General Hadley and Dr. Bellows see Tony sitting in the weeds sipping tea. Making the house reappear, Jeannie produces parents for Roger's visit.Tony comes to the house and forbids Jeannie to marry Roger. Then Dr. Bellows drives up. Seeing the house, he becomes distraught, and runs to Tony. As the house disappears again, they see Roger sitting in the weeds. The following day, Roger tells Tony he found himself wandering around a vacant lot. When he returned to apologize, Jeannie and the house were gone. Smiling at Jeannie, hiding in his desk drawer, Tony assures Roger he Will let him know if he ever meets Jeannie again.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Learning that Dr. Bellows has told General Peterson that Tony should marry for his emotional stability as an astronaut, Jeannie prepares for the wedding. She produces Phoney, a twin of Tony's, who starts romancing her as an example for Tony. Getting nowhere, Jeannie makes Phoney disappear. Later, Dr. Bellows sees a romantic interlude between Jeannie and Phoney and leaves Tony's house, certain a wedding has been set for the following Sunday afternoon. Although Tony tries to get out of his predicament, he realizes he is stuck when the General congratulates him on his coming wedding. Later, Tony tells Jeannie he is going through with the affair.Jeannie produces Phoney to show Tony how to act at the wedding. Phoney tries to get Jeannie to marry him before she makes him vanish. At the chapel, Jeannie runs away at the last moment. At home, Tony tries unsuccessfully to make Jeannie believe it was actually Phoney who appeared at the wedding. Sure it was Tony, Jeannie tells she ran away after deciding never to force herself on him. When Tony musingly asks what would happen had they gotten married, Jeannie insinuates he will never know.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: Get Me To Mecca On Time
programme.desc: Jeannie finds her strength and power to perform magic weakening. Tony makes her promise to rest during the day. programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: After telling Tony that he and Roger Healey have been tapped for a historic two-man space probe, scheduled to blast off the following week, Dr. Bellows asks him to report for a final check-up. programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Feeling that Jeannie must widen her horizons, Tony gives her a book "How To Be A Woman." programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie gets involved with the law when, invisible to everyone, she attempts to drive Tony's car. Angered, Tony orders her to leave. Jeannie returns with her great grandfather, Bilejik, who proves that he can produce fresh water from salt water.When Tony returns to find Bilejik, Jeannie and a policeman are in front of his house. After Bilejik leaves, Tony jubilantly reports to Staples. Staples tells him that these seeds are from a plant extinct for almost two thousand years.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: A series of reports by eleven-year-old Custer to his father, Major Ulysses S. Jamison, on the strange feats of magic at Tony's house results in the Major taking his son to Dr. Bellows, the base psychiatrist. Bellows tells Custer he believes his story, and asks him to keep a close watch on Tony. A policeman catches Dr. Bellows and Custer peering into Tony's window and takes them inside for identification. While Bellows is telling Tony that Custer believes he has seen them levitate, Jeannie causes him to do so. Bellows bows out, feeling he has stumbled on a top-secret aerospace project.Tony voices his nervousness to Jeannie about being spied on by Custer. When Custer disappears, Tony accuses Jeannie of turning him into nothing. Angered, Jeannie leaves. Later, when Custer comes back, having spent the day at a carnival, Tony penitently begins searching for Jeannie. He is sure Jeannie has joined a carnival act and starts a riot at the sideshow when he mistakes a veiled woman for Jeannie. Jeannie returns home and starts pulling down all the shades to outwit Custer.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie is annoyed when Diane Rodney, a friend of Tony's, returns to town, determined to resume their old relationship. Unaware that Jeannie is Roger's date, Tony instructs his friend in the fine art of courtship. Later, when Jeannie tells him she doesn't know her date's name, Tony begins to worry. When Diane arrives, Tony drags her all over town searching for Jeannie. The two couples finally meet at a nightclub. Alone with Jeannie, Tony demands she return home. Jeannie tells him she is going to listen to Roger's records.At Roger's apartment, Jeannie wards off all his attempts at romance. She leaves shortly before Tony pounds on the door looking for her. Tony points out to Roger all the mistakes he would be making if he married her. Convinced, Roger admits Tony has saved him from making a fool of himself. Jeannie is overjoyed by Tony's concern for her. Tony replies that, after all, he is only human.

Jeannie recovers and they leave for home. Thanking Tony for saving her life, Jeannie announces she is taking them to Paris for dinner. Deciding they have traveled enough for one day, Tony takes her to Cocoa Beach instead.

programme.desc: Daniel avslöjar vem som vunnit hans gamla Subaru och varför man aldrig bör däcka hemma hos honom.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Space Shuttle Launch
programme.desc: Daniel begraver "spadtjejen" för gott, delar med sig av fansens "Twisdomsord" till 2014 års studenter och rymdfärjekillen får nätupprättelse.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Perfect Game Bowler
programme.desc: Daniel webbchattar med en get och en bowlare som missade sin chans att få högsta poäng får nätupprättelse.

programme.desc: Daniel firar slutet på sommaren med att ge en pinsam familj nätupprättelse, jagar folk som tagit till sjappen och visar oss sitt mest erotiska klädval hittills.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Lingerie Football Coach
programme.desc: Daniel träffar den enda mannen i världen som bryr sig om damsporter, tar itu med en självskärare på kontoret och firar återkomsten av "Är det rasistiskt?".

programme.desc: Tosh pratar med Vine-gangstan Bryan Silva, Big Ass Baby hamnar i en skitsituation och Daniel läcker nakenbilder på sina fans.

programme.desc: Brooklyns kaxigaste hundexpert får nätupprättelse, Daniel ger oss vardagstips och "Tosh.0" njuter av sommarens sista korvgrillning.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Dumped by Sweetheart
programme.desc: En tonåring med krossat hjärta får nätupprättelse, en förförelsekonstens mästare ger oss tips på hur man får till en trekant och Daniel avslöjar den ritual han utför innan varje program.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Weightlifting
programme.desc: Världens värsta tyngdlyftare får nätupprättelse, Daniel leker "Är det rasistiskt?" och "Tosh.0"-fans förstör sina saker.

programme.desc: Daniel blir en killes storebror och svarar på frågor från barn.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 515
programme.desc: Luma tar med hela familjen för att köpa nya kläder till barnen och Natalie lär Alicia att cykla utan stödhjul. Fayme går på picknick med barnen.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 516
programme.desc: Ellinor berättar om sina amningsproblem. Niffi försöker hålla sina rutiner för att få upp barnen på morgonen och bestämmer sig för att rensa garderoben på kläder.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 517
programme.desc: Luma tar med sig barnen till ett lekland och Natalie lär barnen att plantera växter och sätta frön. Ellinor ska göra gipsavgjutning på Aarons händer och fötter.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 518
programme.desc: Sonia träffar sin syster som inte är speciellt förtjust i hennes planer att bli polis. Natalie känner sig krasslig och blir ompysslad av sina döttrar.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 519
programme.desc: Ellinor och Jimmy tar med Aaron ner till vattnet för att fiska och Niffi tar med sig barnen för att träffa mormor och moster i lekpark. Fayme ska göra en ny tatuering.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 520
programme.desc: Ellinor åker iväg med Aaron på hans första modelljobb för att ta bilder till hennes blogg och Instagramkonto. Natalie vill vänja in sina barn att rida på deras häst Bubben.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 601
programme.desc: I säsongspremiären lär vi känna nya sprudlande mamman Izabell Soldati, och får ett kärt återseende i livet hos frispråkiga och öppensinnade trebarnsmammorna Fayme Elmén och Luma Alalawi.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 602
programme.desc: Ellinor Bjurström berättar om hur det gick att sluta amma sonen Aaron, Sonia Kamikazi längtar efter att börja jobba efter fem års mammaledighet och hos Natalie Eklind pågår storfamiljslivet för fullt.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 603
programme.desc: Izabell berättar för första gången om förlossningen och om de ödestunga minuterna. Luma berättar varför hon väljer att ha slöja, och Fayme har svårt att sluta amma dottern Mila, två år.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 604
programme.desc: Ellinor och Jimmy anlitar en expert på barnsäkerhet för att se vilka faror som finns i deras nybyggda hem. Sonia försöker få Daisy att sluta använda napp. Natalie avslöjar vad hennes nya dröm är.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 605
programme.desc: Faymes son Colin har en selektiv ätstörning och Fayme försöker spåna fram idéer på mat tillsammans med honom. Luma berättar om när hon träffade sin man som 16-åring. Izabell tar ett graviditetstest.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 606
programme.desc: Natalie, Richard och barnen leker i parken och Natalie avslöjar att Richard ska adoptera hennes tre barn. Ellinor och Jimmy ska ta med Aaron på sin första utlandsresa. Sonia tar med barnen till IKEA.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 607

programme.title: Hungry

Autuaan tietämättömänä alueen vaaroista he poikkeavat totutulta reitiltä ainutkertaiseksi povatun seikkailun houkuttelemana. He eivät kuitenkaan voi aavistaa, että heidän retkensä muuttuukin selviytymistaisteluksi suon syvyyksiin kätkeytynyttä nälkäistä virtahepoa vastaan. Kauhujännityselokuva vuodelta 2026.

programme.title: Killing Faith
programme.desc: Killing Faith sijoittuu vuoden 1849 Arizonaan, jota on koetellut rutto. Se kulkee läpi villin lännen, jota ovat koetelleet sairaudet, väkivalta ja huhut jostakin synkästä. Lääkäri saattaa vapautetun orjan ja tämän tyttären kaukaisen uskonparantajan luokse. Matkan varrella häntä koettelevat niin äidin usko riivaukseen ja lääkärin epäilys sairaudesta, sillä kaikki, mihin lapsi koskee, kuolee. Westerntrilleri vuodelta 2025.

programme.title: Roofman - kattokeikkailija
programme.desc: Perustuu uskomattomaan tositarinaan Jeffrey Manchesterista. Vankilasta paennut Jeff piileskelee kuusi kuukautta Toys ”R” Us -lelukaupassa kenenkään huomaamatta ja suunnittelee seuraavaa siirtoaan. Mutta kun hän rakastuu eronneeseen äitiin, Leighin, hänen kaksoiselämänsä alkaa paljastua, mikä käynnistää kiehtovan, uskomattoman ja jännittävän kissa ja hiiri -leikin, kun hänen menneisyytensä alkaa saada häntä kiinni. Rikoskomedia vuodelta 2025.

programme.title: I Wish You All the Best
programme.desc: 18-vuotias Ben päättää kertoa vanhemmilleen olevansa ei-binäärinen. Reaktio on tuhoisa: Ben joutuu lähtemään kotoa ja päätyy asumaan isosiskonsa Hannahin ja tämän aviomiehen Thomasin luokse - ihmisten, joihin Benillä ei ole ollut yhteyttä vuosiin. Uuden arjen keskellä Ben yrittää rakentaa elämänsä uudelleen: uudessa koulussa, uudessa kodissa, uusien ihmisten ympäröimänä. Siellä hän tapaa Nathanin, lämpimän ja avoimen luokkatoverin, joka näkee Benin sellaisena kuin hän todella on. Vähitellen Ben alkaa löytää takaisin omaan ääneensä, voimaansa ja paikkaansa maailmassa. Elokuva on herkkä ja toiveikas kertomus rohkeudesta olla oma itsensä, perhesiteistä, jotka voivat katketa ja kasvaa uudelleen, sekä rakkaudesta ja yhteisöllisyydestä silloin, kun kaikki tuntuu menetetyltä. Tarina tutkii identiteetin, kuulumisen ja aitouden teemoja - ja sitä, miten tärkeää on pysyä uskollisena omalle itselle, vaikka maailma ei ymmärtäisi. Draama vuodelta 2025.

programme.title: Thelma

programme.title: Itse ilkimys 4
programme.desc: Illuminationin jättimenestys, Kätyrit: Grun tarina, oli maailmanlaajuisella yli 1 miljardin dollarin tuotollaan kaikkien aikojen suurin animaatio-franchise. Nyt tarinassa alkaa uusi luku, kun Gru (Oscar®-ehdokas Steve Carrell) ja Lucy (Oscar®-ehdokas Kristen Wiig) ja tyttäret -- Margo (Miranda Cosgrove), Edith (Dana Gaier) ja Agnes (Madison Polan) -- toivottavat tervetulleeksi Gru-perheen uuden jäsenen, Gru Juniorin, jonka aikeena on piinata isäänsä. Grun uusi perivihollinen, Maxime Le Mal (Emmy-voittaja Will Ferrell) ja hänen femme fatale -tyttöystävänsä Valentina (Emmy-ehdokas Sofia Vergara), pakottavat perheen pakosalle. Animoitu perhe-elokuva vuodelta 2024. O: Chris Renaud

programme.title: Let's Love
programme.desc: Huumorintajuinen komedia, jonka pääosissa näyttelevät Martin Freeman, Josh Hutcherson ja Malin Åkerman. Kymmenen vuotta menestyselokuvansa jälkeen Nigel, Andrea, Jackson ja Jess kokoontuvat jälleen Walesissa fanitapahtumaan, jonka on määrä elvyttää heidän uransa. Kun tapahtuma peruutetaan varausvirheen vuoksi, nelikko tarttuu tilaisuuteen ideoida jatko-osaa ja vetäytyy elokuvan alkuperäisille kuvauspaikoille hakemaan inspiraatiota. Pian leirielämän kommellukset, romanttiset jännitteet ja karut totuudet ajavat heidän viikonloppunsa kaaokseen. Komedia vuodelta 2026.

programme.title: Itse ilkimys 4
programme.desc: Illuminationin jättimenestys, Kätyrit: Grun tarina, oli maailmanlaajuisella yli 1 miljardin dollarin tuotollaan kaikkien aikojen suurin animaatio-franchise. Nyt tarinassa alkaa uusi luku, kun Gru (Oscar®-ehdokas Steve Carrell) ja Lucy (Oscar®-ehdokas Kristen Wiig) ja tyttäret -- Margo (Miranda Cosgrove), Edith (Dana Gaier) ja Agnes (Madison Polan) -- toivottavat tervetulleeksi Gru-perheen uuden jäsenen, Gru Juniorin, jonka aikeena on piinata isäänsä. Grun uusi perivihollinen, Maxime Le Mal (Emmy-voittaja Will Ferrell) ja hänen femme fatale -tyttöystävänsä Valentina (Emmy-ehdokas Sofia Vergara), pakottavat perheen pakosalle. Animoitu perhe-elokuva vuodelta 2024. O: Chris Renaud

programme.title: Yö eläintarhassa
programme.desc: Kun meteoriitti iskeytyy Colepepperin eläintarhaan, virus leviää ja muuttaa eläimet zombimaisiksi mutanteiksi. Susi Gracie ja vuorileijona Dan yrittävät pelastaa eläimet ja pysäyttää hullun Bunny Zeron ennen kuin tartunta leviää. Animoitu kauhukomedia vuodelta 2024.

programme.title: The Kiss
programme.desc: Tanska, 1913. Huhut lähestyvästä maailmansodasta kiirivät kaiun lailla pitkin Eurooppaa. Anton Abilgaard on jalo ja tunnollinen nuori mies, jonka tärkein tavoite on suorittaa ratsuväen upseerikoulu kunnialla loppuun. Koittaa kohtalokas ilta, jona hänet kutsutaan tanssiaisiin paikallisen paroni Løvenskjoldin luo. Tietämätön Anton pyytää talon kaunista tytärtä Edithiä tanssimaan, mutta kun hänelle selviää, että tämä on traagisen ratsastusonnettomuuden jäljiltä rampa, nuori luutnantti kärsii tunnontuskista aiheutettuaan tytölle häpeää. Anton tuntee Edithiä kohtaan suurta myötätuntoa, ja Edith rakastuu häneen palavasti. Sääli ja ylpeys eivät kuitenkaan salli Antonin olla Edithille rehellinen, ja hän kietoutuu yhä tiukemmin tuhoisaan lupausten ja valheiden verkkoon. Tanskalainen draama vuodelta 2022.

programme.title: Fackham Hall
programme.desc: Uusi portieeri muodostaa oudon siteen Davenportin perheen nuorimman tyttären kanssa. Davenportit ovat korkea-arvoinen brittiläinen suku, jota johtavat lordi ja lady Davenport. Perheen on selvitettävä tämä tilanne ja samalla myös toinen mahdollisesti katastrofaalinen ongelma: vanhimman tyttären ja hänen häikäilemättömän serkkunsa suunniteltu avioliitto. Brittiläinen komedia vuodelta 2025.

programme.title: Hitpig!
programme.desc: Hitpig (Jason Sudeikis), palkkionmetsästäjä-sika, joka pyydystää karanneita eläimiä, saa uransa suurimman keikan: palauttaa tanssivan elefantin Pickles (Lilly Singh) mielipuoliselle Vegas-showmiehelle (Rainn Wilson). Tehtävä paisuu villiksi seikkailuksi ympäri maailmaa. Lopulta Hitpig oivaltaa, että suurin palkinto ei tule vangitsemisesta vaan vapaaksi päästämisessä. Animoitu seikkailukomedia vuodelta 2024.

programme.title: Fishing for Love

programme.title: Love and Where to Find It
programme.desc: Two local coffee shop business owners despise each other in real life, but fall in love while unknowingly sending each other messages via a dating app on their friends’ behalf.

programme.desc: Tired of her fast-paced life in the city, Sophie Carter travels to a small seaside town to disconnect and self-reflect, staying at an Airbnb run by a widowed father of a young girl. programme.title: The Dating List

programme.title: Fantastic Mr. Fox
programme.desc: An urbane fox cannot resist returning to his farm raiding ways and then must help his community survive the farmers' retaliation.

programme.title: 10 Truths About Love
programme.desc: Hannah, a thriving romance columnist, thinks she’s got life and love figured out… until her longtime boyfriend unexpectedly breaks up with her. At the same time, Hannah’s editor hires a new writer, Liam, to work with her and give the column a male perspective. The two clash over their approach and sparks fly.

programme.title: Guess Who
programme.desc: Theresa, a young woman, takes her boyfriend, Simon, home to introduce him to her parents and share the surprise of their engagement. There's another twist: Simon is white.

programme.title: Cooking with Love
programme.desc: Hardworking & optimistic television producer, Kelly, doesn’t have time for love. Along with her mentor Amanda, Kelly dives into another season of the Little Gourmet, a kids cooking show, when hot-headed Chef Stephen is dropped into Kelly’s life as a last minute replacement host. As the two struggle to make peace and a successful show, they realize they have a lot more in common than they thought – a love of food, the kids they encounter & each other.

All under the watchful eye of her handsome but infuriating bodyguard, Noah.
